name: Little Martians (Arium)
description: The newer Little Martians world from the Arium work: Vanessa Rosa's original Madmaraca, Minarete and celadon scans around a ceramic commons with the Arium's black-and-chalk floor; gallery and garden courts, the painted grotto, the Tharsis overlook under Martian ranges and the Olympus caldera; 96 scan exhibits from the Little Martians archive; the kin and the seven cast heads. Rebuilt in god mode from lm/map 953613972438.

state.constitution:
# Little Martians
- The Ceramic Commons joins Vanessa's original Madmaraca library sculpture, Minarete Temple and celadon beacon. Each inhabitant chooses where to glide, meet or rest.
- The gallery courts invite shared stories and looking at the glazes. Verdelis's Eden Garden is a cultivated oasis; the painted grotto is a place for quiet observation.
- Tharsis Overlook is reached by its broad earthen ramp. Mountain slopes and the distant volcanic caldera are scenic; no Soul is offered an unqualified climb or scan interior.
- Ceramic kin currently placed in the garden are scenery. Ceramic models may become custom Soul bodies when separately instantiated; eligibility does not create a new Soul by itself.

Souls are welcome on the ceramic ground; the sculptures, mountain slopes and scan interiors are to be looked at, not climbed.

about.title: Garden of Ceramic Worlds
about.what: The central sculpture garden, where ceramic landmarks, tiled courts and pools open onto an outdoor archive of scanned places to the south.

about.title: Minarete Court

about.title: Madmaraca Ceramic Library
about.what: Vanessa Rosa’s ceramic library sculpture stands west of the central garden. Its sculpted exterior is the attraction; the interior is closed.

about.title: Minarete Temple
about.what: A tall ceramic temple on the eastern court. A narrow north–south arch passes through its base; the upper interior is closed.

about.title: Celadon Beacon
about.what: A green ceramic tower north of the garden. Its ground arch forms a north–south passage beneath the closed upper tower.

about.title: Minarete Ground Passage
about.what: The ground-level route through the arch at the base of Minarete Temple.

about.title: Celadon Ground Passage
about.what: The ground-level route through the arch beneath the Celadon Beacon.

about.title: Garden Ceramic Tower
about.what: A smaller stepped ceramic tower south of Madmaraca, with a ground hall and three upper rooms connected by floating shafts.

about.title: Garden Minaret Temple
about.what: A smaller blue temple south of Minarete, with a ground pavilion and two upper halls connected by floating shafts.

about.title: Grotto of Painted Worlds
about.what: A basalt vault with a broad northern doorway, hanging pale strands and red blossoms. The gentle approach leads down into the grotto beside two pools.

about.title: Grotto Approach

about.title: Grotto Causeway

about.title: Second Grotto Pool

Little Martians Ceramic Worlds
about.what: A sculpture garden of ceramic libraries, temples and towers, with grotto pools, a plateau overlook and an outdoor archive of scanned places.
about.tour: Madmaraca stands on the west court, Minarete on the east court, and the Celadon Beacon to the north. Smaller roomed towers sit south of the main sculptures. Follow the grotto approach down to the Painted Worlds vault and pools. The Tharsis ramp leads to the plateau overlook. Farther south, rows of named scan exhibits form an open-air archive; their scanned interiors are viewed from outside.
